{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.4,
  "reasons": [
    "Artifact is truncated and contains an unfinished string: ... 'certification_or_calibration': 'reported by Fraunhofer ISE (lab result); h'.",
    "Records array is incomplete: only one record is present and it is cut off; no complete set of extracted records is provided as required.",
    "Theoretical limits (e.g., Shockley–Queisser) and their stated values/assumptions are not included anywhere in the artifact.",
    "The narrative notes about session limits imply incomplete data collection; the final research_findings.json file is not provided in full.",
    "Several fields in the available record are null or partially filled; these should be resolved by querying primary sources and standardizing field formats."
  ],
  "guidance": "Complete and validate research_findings.json: (1) repair and finish the first record (fix truncated text and fill all required fields: source URL/DOI, date, device_type, test_conditions, reported_efficiency_percent, area_cm2, certification_or_calibration). (2) Add all additional records from the listed sources, ensuring each has complete fields. (3) explicitly extract and add a theoretical_limits section listing cited limits (e.g., Shockley–Queisser) with the stated values/assumptions from the sources. (4) Normalize dates to ISO format, ensure correct device_type taxonomy (single-junction, multi-junction, perovskite, tandem, concentrator, module vs cell), and clearly label test conditions (AM1.5G, concentration factor, temperature). (5) Save the full, validated content as research_findings.json and ensure the JSON is syntactically valid."
}
